versioning.convention: Reconstructed product milestones, not public API compatibility or verified production release dates. One entry per development date; major workflow milestones reset minor and patch; capability dates increment minor; corrections, compatibility, documentation and checkpoints increment patch.
versioning.prior_evidence: No release tags in either repository. package.json remained at scaffold version 0.1.0 throughout committed history.
